---
title: "Citations"
---

The atlas, its scalings and the external datasets come from other groups' work. If you use
one of them, cite the source listed here.

| What you used | What to cite | DOI or link |
|---|---|---|
| The Allen CCF and its annotations | Wang Q et al. (2020), "The Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework: A 3D Reference Atlas", *Cell* 181(4). Allen Mouse Brain Atlas (2015) with region annotations (2017), © Allen Institute for Brain Science | [10.1016/j.cell.2020.04.007](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2020.04.007) |
| The Needles scaling (`NeedlesAtlas`) | Dorr AE et al. (2008), "High resolution three-dimensional brain atlas using an average magnetic resonance image of 40 adult C57Bl/6J mice", *NeuroImage* 42(1) | [10.1016/j.neuroimage.2008.03.037](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuroimage.2008.03.037) |
| The MRI Toronto scaling (`MRITorontoAtlas`) | Qiu LR et al. (2018), "Mouse MRI shows brain areas relatively larger in males emerge before those larger in females", *Nat Commun* 9, 2615 | [10.1038/s41467-018-04921-2](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-018-04921-2) |
| The Swanson flat map | Hahn JD et al. (2021), "An open access mouse brain flatmap and upgraded rat and human brain flatmaps based on current reference atlases", *J Comp Neurol* 529(3). Swanson LW (2018), "Brain maps 4.0", *J Comp Neurol* | [10.1002/cne.24966](https://doi.org/10.1002/cne.24966), [10.1002/cne.24381](https://doi.org/10.1002/cne.24381) |
| The cortical flat map and the streamlines | Wang Q et al. (2020), as for the Allen CCF above | [10.1016/j.cell.2020.04.007](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2020.04.007) |
| The Beryl mapping | International Brain Laboratory et al. (2025), "A brain-wide map of neural activity during complex behaviour", *Nature* 645, 177–191 | [10.1038/s41586-025-09235-0](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09235-0) |
| Gene expression (AGEA) | Lein ES et al. (2007), "Genome-wide atlas of gene expression in the adult mouse brain", *Nature* 445, 168–176. Ng L et al. (2009), "An anatomic gene expression atlas of the adult mouse brain", *Nature Neuroscience* 12, 356–362 | [10.1038/nature05453](https://doi.org/10.1038/nature05453), [10.1038/nn.2281](https://doi.org/10.1038/nn.2281) |
| MERFISH cell types | Yao Z et al. (2023), "A high-resolution transcriptomic and spatial atlas of cell types in the whole mouse brain", *Nature* 624, 317–332. Zhang M et al. (2023), "Molecularly defined and spatially resolved cell atlas of the whole mouse brain", *Nature* 624, 343–354 | [10.1038/s41586-023-06812-z](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06812-z), [10.1038/s41586-023-06808-9](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06808-9) |
| Lipids | Fusar Bassini L et al. (2026), "The lipidomic architecture of the mouse brain", *Nature*. Source data on Zenodo. The volumes are a derivative distributed under CC-BY 4.0, so any use must credit the original work | [10.1038/s41586-026-11050-0](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11050-0), [10.5281/zenodo.15379565](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15379565) |
| Mesoscale connectivity | Oh SW et al. (2014), "A mesoscale connectome of the mouse brain", *Nature* 508. Knox JE et al. (2018), "High-resolution data-driven model of the mouse connectome", *Network Neuroscience* 3 | [10.1038/nature13186](https://doi.org/10.1038/nature13186), [10.1162/netn_a_00066](https://doi.org/10.1162/netn_a_00066) |
| The cortico-thalamic hierarchy | Harris JA et al. (2019), "Hierarchical organization of cortical and thalamic connectivity", *Nature* 575 | [10.1038/s41586-019-1716-z](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-019-1716-z) |
